Protection Paladin Tank Gear and Best in Slot — 12.1

2.

Trinket Recommendations for Protection Paladin

Ranking Trinkets
S Tier
  • Zul'jin's Guillotine Technique
  • Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
A Tier
  • Gebbo's Bottomless Bag - Click for Details The buff from this trinket is pretty good, but you have no control over which secondary stat gets buffed or when it gets buffed. The high proc rate counters this.
  • Venomous Gladiator's Badge of Ferocity - Click for Details This trinket gives you a large amount of Strength every minute. It lines up perfectly with our cooldowns with one big downside... You need to do PvP. As it is a PvP item it will have a fixed item level, and be outscaled by fully upgraded Hero Track trinkets and any Myth trinket on this list.
B Tier
  • Vile Vial of Volatile Venom - Click for Details Random secondary stats on a 2 minute cooldown. Will line up for every other use of Avenging Wrath but could roll Mastery making it not very powerful. It also has a downside of reducing that secondary stat afterwards which would be when you are falling out of Sentinel.
  • Merektha's Fang
Defensive Trinkets
  • First Mate's Shellward - Click for Details 1m30s big absorb shield. It's arguably the best option available for something that is both controlable and you can incorporate into a cooldown plan.
  • Tumor of the Swarm - Click for Details Random absorbs. When seeking defensive trinkets you want it to solve an issue which this does not facilitate as you cannot control when the effects occur.
  • Idol of the Howling Nexus - Click for Details A strange trinket that gives you a flat amount of Mastery but only gives you the Strength when it procs, so you are actively weaker as a tank until it triggers. On average any other trinket would give you more of a Defensive gain due to the passive Strength (which is armour, and more damage so your rotational absorbs are stronger).
